stories.title: Back-Nine Bandit
stories.detail: 22 coming home after 12 out - turned it right on

stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.detail: 4 wipes from 18 holes - the scorecard is mostly fresh air
